featured_reviews.review_text:
5 star over and over again!! These guys were fantastic from start to end. I was travelling through India for my connecting flight back home, I was struggling getting from A to B without a working phone, so I asked the information  desk at the airport if you could recommend a phone repair shop, and they recommended  Mobile Point Sales and Service.  The information desk kindly called the shop on my behalf, who came and picked me up from the airport, took me directly to the shop and within a very short amount of time, fixed my phone, provided me a new charger, new case and screen protector. As I was in a new country, the whole process at start felt a little overwhelming, but these guys completely put me at ease, and I couldnt have been happier with my experience!

Many thanks again for everything!
